name: Prime Inference
description: Serves hosted open models and gateway access to third-party models through one OpenAI-compatible API, with rerank and classify endpoints and a CLI.

skills.name: Chat Completions
skills.description: Sends OpenAI-style chat completion requests to hosted or gateway models by catalog ID with one Prime API key.

skills.name: List Models
skills.description: Lists available model IDs, serving type and pricing through the models endpoint or the prime inference models command.

skills.name: Rerank Results
skills.description: Orders search results by relevance to a query with the hosted Qwen3 Reranker through the Rerank API.

skills.name: Classify and Score
skills.description: Classifies and scores content with hosted evaluation models such as Clef through the Classify and Evaluations APIs.
